content.title: Intel, Fedex, Cardlytics, Brera, : Trending Stocks
content.description: Intel (INTC) skyrocketed yesterday, closing more than 22% higher after Nvidia (NVDA) announced its $5 billion investment in the company, as part of a push to produce more AI hardware and products in the US. Fedex (FDX) is in focus after reporting results late yesterday that beat analysts’ expectations despite tariff headwinds, and we take a look at a tiny company that has become the market’s latest rocket ship: Brera Holdings (BREA). Plus, Cardlytics (CDLX) soars on hopes that it will benefit from American Express' (AXP) new Platinum cards. For more live coverage of markets watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and head to Yahoo Finance.

content.title: The Latest Crypto Treasury Punt: Art Laffer and a Mongolian Soccer Team Owner
content.summary: The investor craze for boosting public companies' shares by loading them up with crypto is getting stranger.  A tiny sports company that owns a portfolio of obscure soccer teams, including squads in Mozambique and Mongolia, said Thursday it had raised $300 million from investors to accumulate the cryptocurrency solana.  Arthur Laffer, the economist who invented the famous Laffer Curve, which depicts the relationship between tax revenue and tax rates, is joining its board.
